title: Report or distinguish same-turn provider tool-key reuse instead of silently reusing an old test execution
outcome: A later invocation that reuses the same provider tool key in the same runtime and turn is either identified as a distinct occurrence or explicitly reported as an identity collision, without borrowing the first execution's authority or silently losing its observation.
acceptance: Report or distinguish same-turn provider tool-key reuse instead of silently reusing an old test execution is done
